rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A hou2 ging1 ngaa6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that something amazes or surprises someone.

example.english: His magic can amaze the whole audience.
example.traditional: 佢嘅魔術搞到全場觀眾好驚訝。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 mo1 seot6 gaau2 dou3 cyun4 coeng4 gun1 zung3 hou2 ging1 ngaa6

rows.note: Use this when the amazement is sudden or shocking, with a sense of startling the person.

example.english: That sudden bang can amaze me.
example.traditional: 嗰一下巨響可以嚇親我。
example.jyutping: go2 jat1 haa5 geoi6 hoeng2 ho2 ji5 haak3 can1 ngo5
